valuation.method: Forward Adjusted EPS x P/E (FY2027 adjusted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date), cross-checked against Adjusted Book Value ($54.21/share at Q3 2026)

bear.driver: Japan yen weakness and higher U.S. benefit ratios compress margins

base.driver: Steady U.S. profitability and ongoing share repurchases offset modest Japan top-line and FX headwinds

bull.driver: Favorable JPY/USD FX, disciplined benefit ratios, and accelerated buybacks

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027 adj. EPS of $7.75, the $127.61 close implies 16.5x forward P/E (and 2.35x Q3 2026 adjusted book value of $54.21/sh); at 16.0x, the close implies $7.98 EPS.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E on $7.75 base EPS moves the base target by $7.75 (6.1 pp of price return).
valuation.watch_metric: Aflac Japan net earned premiums (ex-FX) and U.S. benefit ratio

analyst_notes: Published Street consensus sits around Hold with an average 12-month target near $117.50-$120.60 (range ~$101-$143), slightly below our $124.00 base case (-2.8% vs. $127.61 close). Individual dated calls with verified pre-cutoff timestamps were not available for the event table (Morgan Stanley's Nigel Dally raised his target to $136 on 2026-11-23, after the 2026-11-13 cutoff, and other broker targets such as UBS $125, Wells Fargo $124, KBW $123, Raymond James $123, Mizuho $118, Evercore ISI $116, and Barclays $101 lacked verified issue timestamps).
